summary:
艾伯維EPS超預期2.2%，季度營收逾166億美元顯示免疫新藥組合動能延續。
• EPS 2.71美元，超出預期2.65美元，超預期幅度2.16%
• 營收166.2億美元，為公司季度高水準，反映產品組合廣度
• 免疫學新藥組合持續貢獻成長，獲利穩定達標
• 現金流支撑高股息政策，吸引收益型投資人
ai_view:
訊號穩健：EPS溫和超預期，季度營收逾166億美元維持高水準，顯示免疫學產品組合動能延續。短期股價中性偏多，營收年增率未揭露使成長判讀需審慎。中期重點在新藥放量是否足以對沖Humira流失與藥價壓力。追蹤指標：核心免疫藥營收、營業利潤率、股息覆蓋率、管線里程碑與全年指引。

需留意：營收年增率未揭露，成長動能須結合趨勢判讀；108倍本益比偏高，獲利不及預期時下修壓力大；藥價政策與生物相似藥競爭為結構性逆風

summary_en:
AbbVie beat EPS by 2.2% with $16.6B revenue, as the immunology franchise sustains momentum.
• EPS of $2.71 beat the $2.65 estimate by 2.16%
• Revenue of $16.62B, a strong quarterly level, reflects portfolio breadth
• The immunology franchise keeps contributing growth with steady earnings delivery
• Cash flow supports a high-dividend policy attractive to income investors

ai_view_en:
Signal is steady: a modest EPS beat with $16.6B revenue keeps the immunology franchise's momentum intact. Near-term neutral-to-positive, though undisclosed YoY warrants caution on growth reads. Mid-term, the key is whether new-drug ramp offsets Humira erosion and pricing pressure. Track: core immunology sales, operating margin, dividend coverage, pipeline milestones and full-year guidance.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed, so momentum must be read against the trend; An elevated 108x P/E raises downside risk on any earnings shortfall; Drug-pricing policy and biosimilar competition are structural headwinds
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 / EPS超預期2.16%屬溫和達標（營收年增率未揭露）。
